text: The cat is sleeping _____ the sofa.
options: on
at
to
between

wrong.at: at 用在小點或地點，貓在沙發「上面」要用 on。
wrong.to: to 表示方向「往」，不表示位置。
wrong.between: between 需要兩個對象，如 between A and B，這句只有沙發一個。

why: 接觸並在表面上方，用 on。
tip: on 表示接觸在表面上。
say: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

prompt: 哪一句時間介系詞是正確的？
options: The class starts in 9:00.
The class starts at 9:00.
The class starts on 9:00.

in 用在較長的時間，如 in May；幾點鐘要用 at。
on 用在日期和星期，幾點鐘要用 at。

why: at 用在確切的時間點，如 at 9:00。
tip: at 時間點，on 日期星期，in 月份年份。

prompt: 路人問你書店在哪裡，書店就在銀行和花店的中間。
options: It's between the bank and the flower shop.
It's among the bank and the flower shop.
It's beside the bank and the flower shop.
It's behind of the bank and the flower shop.
answer: It's between the bank and the flower shop.

among 用在三者以上的範圍中；兩個地點之間用 between。
wrong.It's beside the bank and the flower shop: beside 是「在旁邊」，一次只指一個對象，不表示在兩者中間。
wrong.It's behind of the bank and the flower s: behind 後面不接 of，意思也變成「在後面」。

why: 兩個地點的中間用 between A and B。
tip: between A and B：在兩者中間。
say: It's between the bank and the flower shop.

text: To get to the museum, go straight and turn _____ at the second corner.
options: left
to left
on left
the left

wrong.to left: turn left 的 left 是副詞，前面不加 to。
wrong.on left: on the left 才是「在左邊」，turn on left 不是正確說法。
wrong.the left: turn 後面直接接 left，不加 the。

why: turn left／right 是固定說法，left 直接放在 turn 後面。
say: Go straight and turn left at the second corner.

prompt: 哪一句交通方式的說法是正確的？
options: My uncle goes to work by bike.
My uncle goes to work by a bike.
My uncle goes to work by the bike.
answer: My uncle goes to work by bike.

by + 交通工具時，交通工具前面不加 a。
說交通方式的 by 後面不加 the。

why: by + 交通工具（不加冠詞）表示搭乘的方式。
tip: by bike、by bus，不加 a 或 the。
say: My uncle goes to work by bike.

text: The convenience store is next to the post office.
options: 便利商店在郵局隔壁。
便利商店在郵局對面。
便利商店在郵局裡面。
便利商店在郵局後面。

wrong.便利商店在郵局對面。: 對面是 across from 或 opposite，next to 是緊鄰。
wrong.便利商店在郵局裡面。: 裡面要用 in 或 inside。
wrong.便利商店在郵局後面。: 後面是 behind，next to 是旁邊。

why: next to 表示緊鄰在旁邊。
say: The convenience store is next to the post office.

prompt: 有人問你：「請問車站怎麼走？」你想說「直走兩個街區，它就在你的左手邊。」
options: Go straight for two blocks. It's on your left.
Go straight two blocks. It's in your left.
Go straight for two blocks. It's at left of you.
Go straight to two blocks. It's on you left.
answer: Go straight for two blocks. It's on your left.

wrong.Go straight two blocks. It's in your lef: 左手邊要說 on your left，不是 in your left。
wrong.Go straight for two blocks. It's at left: at left of you 不是自然的說法，「在你左邊」要說 on your left。
wrong.Go straight to two blocks. It's on you l: to 不能這樣表示距離，且 you 要改成所有格 your。

why: 指路時，on your left／right 表示在你的左邊／右邊。
say: Go straight for two blocks. It's on your left.

text: The students are walking _____ the bridge to get to the other side of the river.
options: across
between
under
in

wrong.between: between 需要兩個對象，不表示從一邊走到另一邊。
wrong.under: under 是在橋下面，但他們要到河的另一邊，是走在橋上橫越。
wrong.in: in 表示在裡面，不適合說橫越一座橋。

why: 從一邊走到另一邊，用 across。
tip: across 表示橫越、從這一邊到另一邊。
say: The students are walking across the bridge.

options: The hospital is in front the school.
The hospital is in front of the school.
The hospital is front of the school.
answer: The hospital is in front of the school.

in front 後面要接 of 才能接名詞。
front 前面少了 in，固定說法是 in front of。

tip: in front of：在前面，要有 in 也要有 of。
say: The hospital is in front of the school.

prompt: 外國遊客想知道公車站離這裡遠不遠，其實走路五分鐘就到。
options: It's a five-minute walk from here.
It's five minute walk from here.
It's a five-minutes walk from here.
It has five minutes walk from here.
answer: It's a five-minute walk from here.

五分鐘步行 five-minute walk 前面要加 a。
當形容詞用的複合詞，minute 不加 s：five-minute。
說距離和路程用 It's，不用 has。

why: a five-minute walk 是固定說法，表示五分鐘的路程。
tip: 數字加單位當形容詞，單位不加 s。
say: It's a five-minute walk from here.

text: The zoo is far _____ here, so we need to take a taxi.
options: from
to
at
of

wrong.to: far to 不是這個意思的說法，說離某處很遠要用 far from。
wrong.at: at 不能接在 far 後面表示距離。
wrong.of: of 不能用來表示離某處的距離。

say: The zoo is far from here, so we need to take a taxi.

options: The ball is under of the table.
The ball is under the table.
The ball is at under the table.
answer: The ball is under the table.

under 本身就是介系詞，後面直接接名詞，不用加 of。
兩個介系詞不能這樣疊在一起，只用 under 就好。

why: under 是介系詞，後面直接接名詞。
tip: under 後面直接接名詞，不加 of。
say: The ball is under the table.

text: Turn right at the traffic light, and you will see the park on your left.
options: 在紅綠燈右轉，你會看到公園在你的左手邊。
在紅綠燈左轉，你會看到公園在你的右手邊。
在紅綠燈直走，公園在你的後面。
在公園右轉，你會看到紅綠燈。
answer: 在紅綠燈右轉，你會看到公園在你的左手邊。

wrong.在紅綠燈左轉，你會看到公園在你的右手邊。: 句子是 turn right 右轉，on your left 是在左邊，方向全部相反。
wrong.在紅綠燈直走，公園在你的後面。: 句中是 Turn right，不是直走，公園也不是在後面。
wrong.在公園右轉，你會看到紅綠燈。: 轉彎的地點是紅綠燈，不是公園，順序弄反了。

why: turn right 是右轉，on your left 是在左手邊。
tip: 聽指路，先抓住 turn 和 on 後面的方向字。
say: Turn right at the traffic light, and you will see the park on your left.
